_comment: Fake remote CKAN catalogue harvested by CKAN's ckan_harvester. Edit and re-run showcase/05-harvest-lifecycle.sh to see updates propagate. Ids must be UUIDs (they become the local dataset ids).

organizations.name: jmg-malaysia
organizations.title: Minerals and Geoscience Department Malaysia (mock)
organizations.description: Mock organisation from the remote catalogue

datasets.name: world-countries-natural-earth
datasets.title: World country boundaries (Natural Earth 1:10m) - mock federated
datasets.notes: Country boundaries published by a partner GeoServer (ahocevar.com, the OpenLayers examples server). Harvested into AMConnect from a mock member-state CKAN. Both WMS and WFS are offered by the remote server, so the layer is viewable AND downloadable if the remote is reachable.

resources.name: Countries (WMS)
resources.description: WMS view service on the partner GeoServer

resources.name: Countries (WFS)
resources.description: WFS feature service on the partner GeoServer (GeoJSON / GML / CSV / Shapefile download)

datasets.name: malaysia-mineral-occurrences-mock
datasets.title: Malaysia mineral occurrences (mock, view-only WMS)
datasets.notes: Illustrative record from a mock member-state CKAN. The only service is an external WMS with no WFS/WCS behind it, so AMConnect must present it as view-only. (The WMS URL points at the OpenStreetMap WMS of terrestris because no real service exists for this mock record.)

resources.name: Mineral occurrences (WMS, view only)
resources.description: External WMS only; no download service exists
